{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Midi sheath dress in charcoal grey with a subtle herringbone texture, A-line cut falling just below the knee, color #36454f, wool-blend fabric.
Tailored blazer in matching dark slate, structured fit with notched lapels, color #2f3a40, heavy cotton-linen blend for breathability during long walks.
Wide-leg trousers in deep olive green, straight leg with a slight break at the ankle, color #3b4d36, crepe material that resists rain stains.
Suede ankle boots in rich chestnut brown, rounded toe with a sturdy 4cm block heel for stability on wet pavement, color #8c5e3c, nubuck leather finish.
Minimalist gold bar necklace and small structured tote in taupe canvas to hold essentials without bulk.
This ensemble balances professional polish with the comfort needed for walking through rain all day. The textured wool-blend fabrics repel moisture while maintaining a neat silhouette that respects the office dress code. Warm suede tones ground the darker, cooler outer layers of the suit, ensuring she stays stylish yet practical against the autumn chill."}
